19rttr97: They issued Cyril Rttr a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept his mother's thimble in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first. Cyril Rttr asked to leave the chaplains and serve as a rifleman. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Cyril Rttr did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Cyril Rttr. Cyril Rttr read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Viktor Imposterdonu of the Concord lost a harmonica in no man's land at the Hanging Bridge. Cyril Rttr of the Hegemony found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Cyril Rttr. Cyril Rttr read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Cyril Rttr got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 843. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Cyril Rttr could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Cyril Rttr owes Quentin Elo so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.

Cyril Rttr and Quentin Elo divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion. Mail came up the line with a letter for Cyril Rttr. Cyril Rttr read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Wiring party. Cyril Rttr held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-C5, and everyone came back. Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Clement Lynallwarrio stood up to sing louder, and Cyril Rttr fired. Clement Lynallwarrio was grazed. The singing stopped. Mail came up the line with a letter for Cyril Rttr. Cyril Rttr read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Cyril Rttr waited for that to change. When it did, Pavel Singh was grazed.

Cyril Rttr threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Marek Valiantlyval was down and screaming for a medic. (@valiantlyvaliancy) The Concord sentry, Leopold Mejci, shouted once. Cyril Rttr silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@tejci_mejci66) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Cyril Rttr snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Cyril Rttr free. The runner said a letter for Cyril Rttr had come up with the ammunition. Cyril Rttr went to get it before the ammunition.
The wound looked small. It was not. Cyril Rttr was carried back with a fever and a hand that would not stop shaking.
adxxm: Emil Adxxm reported to Q-S9 with a tin whistle sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Emil Adxxm wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Emil Adxxm was faster. Ulrich Yoye was badly wounded. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into Q-S9. Emil Adxxm has learned to walk bent double.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Emil Adxxm aimed a step ahead and fired: Quentin Lcamillo, badly wounded.
Emil Adxxm sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Emil Adxxm was hit in the forearm at Q-S9. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind.
The medic cut the last bandage off Emil Adxxm's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to Q-S9 the same hour.
Emil Adxxm went over with the night raiders and never came back. The flare caught Emil Adxxm on the wire, halfway home.
Lucien Adxxm had heard about Emil Adxxm's courage. At Q-S9, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Lucien Adxxm saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at Q-S9 and fired once. Bram Industriousb was badly wounded. A bullet went into Lucien Adxxm's chest just under the heart at Q-S9. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Viktor "Spark" Hobbybunker of the Hegemony (@baronpapas_hobbybunker). Lucien Adxxm did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
Dorian "Parson" Adxxm put a tin whistle beside the bunk. Someone who had known Lucien Adxxm helped clear the shelf without saying why.
alvacatraska: They issued Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a pressed cornflower in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska wrote down the news without trying to explain it. Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska asked to leave the signallers and serve as a stretcher bearer. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska had just lit a cigarette at Q-F14 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Bram Amanatidis of the Hegemony (@amanatidis511). The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

The medics cleaned Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at Q-F14. A letter from home reached Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska before dusk. Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska read it twice and slept a little easier.

Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back. A letter from home reached Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska before dusk. Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska read it twice and slept a little easier.

Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour. A letter from home reached Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska before dusk. Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska read it twice and slept a little easier.

Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. A letter from home reached Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska before dusk. Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska read it twice and slept a little easier.

An officer heard about the singing and forbade it. Tonight Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska only whistled the first bar. Across the wire, someone whistled the last. Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska found a letter on the fire step, left by the runner. Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska read it while the kettle boiled.

Norbert "Hollow" Viking and Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button. Norbert "Parson" Alvacatraska reported for duty as a machine gunner. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
cdub_b1: The sergeant gave Zeno Cdub a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Zeno Cdub listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Zeno Cdub asked to see the second one. The barber laughed. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Zeno Cdub answered to number 898. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Zeno Cdub helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Zeno Cdub drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
Zeno Cdub's hands still remember being a lamplighter's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
Zeno Cdub gave Gideon Alt the last match in the trench. Gideon used it to light a candle so that Zeno could finish a letter.
Zeno Cdub borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Dorian Fuadhekal was grazed.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Zeno Cdub waited for that to change. When it did, Walter Metropolitan was badly wounded.
Zeno Cdub has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Oskar Elementalher, grazed.
chickenman7989: Casimir Chickenman arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a child's drawing of a horse and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Casimir Chickenman felt a hard tug at his hip at Q-F12. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Jonas Justafungi of the Concord (@justafungi77). Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Casimir Chickenman could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Casimir Chickenman is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Casimir Chickenman wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Casimir Chickenman wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
In the fog a figure walked along the parapet of Q-F12. When Casimir Chickenman challenged it, there was nobody there.
A loose strip of canvas snapped above Casimir Chickenman's bunk. He tied it down and received thanks from six apparently sleeping men.
Casimir Chickenman reached up to fix a sandbag at Q-F12 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Bastian Deionmurillo of the Concord (@deionmurillo).

Casimir Chickenman was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at Q-F12. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Silas Mcgrail of the Concord (@patrick.t.mcgrail). Casimir Chickenman did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
Gustav "Ash" Chickenman joined Q-F12 under the shadow of Casimir Chickenman's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

A bullet went through Gustav "Ash" Chickenman's upper arm at Q-F12 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Walter "Saint" Williemcminn of the Concord (@williemcminn7022). Gustav "Ash" Chickenman stood up to fix a loose sandbag at Q-F12. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Walter "Saint" Williemcminn of the Concord (@williemcminn7022).
Walter "Shadow" Chickenman joined Q-F12 under the shadow of Gustav "Ash" Chickenman's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
christian._.ayers: Norbert "Ghost" Ayers stepped off the supply cart at S-R12 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

Norbert "Ghost" Ayers felt a hard tug at his hip at S-R12. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Oskar Urfavv of the Concord (@urfavv__j). Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Norbert "Ghost" Ayers shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Norbert "Ghost" Ayers's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-R12 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Norbert "Ghost" Ayers folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Norbert "Ghost" Ayers hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
Norbert "Ghost" Ayers got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
Norbert "Ghost" Ayers sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Norbert "Ghost" Ayers asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
Norbert "Ghost" Ayers and Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.

Norbert "Ghost" Ayers had just lit a cigarette at S-R12 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Oskar Urfavv of the Concord (@urfavv__j).
connordavidscott: Tobias Connordavids came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Tobias Connordavids watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Tobias Connordavids shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Bram Roma, was grazed. Tobias Connordavids reached up to fix a sandbag at S-R6 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Dietrich Wolfmananton of the Hegemony (@wolfmanantony). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Tobias Connordavids answered to number 882. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Tobias Connordavids stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
The wound on Tobias Connordavids's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
Tobias Connordavids watched a woman sweep her doorstep. He had forgotten that dirt could be removed permanently from anywhere.
Tobias Connordavids smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Casimir Oliverjarret came out for a cup and was badly wounded.
The whole squad at S-R6 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Tobias Connordavids's bullet that found Wendel Gers, badly wounded.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Tobias Connordavids spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.

Tobias Connordavids was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-R6. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Valentin Aklouisza of the Hegemony (@aklouisza).
danielmcmenamy: Konrad Danielmcmena took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Water rose to the second step of the dugout. Konrad Danielmcmena moved a tin of tobacco to the highest shelf and sat beside it like a guard.

Konrad Danielmcmena found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: an old man with a dog, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire. A letter from home found Konrad Danielmcmena before the night shift. Konrad Danielmcmena folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet went through Konrad Danielmcmena's sleeve at R-F6 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. A letter from home found Konrad Danielmcmena before the night shift. Konrad Danielmcmena folded it small and kept it close. Word came down the line: Hill 304 is ours. Konrad Danielmcmena shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Konrad Danielmcmena is whole again, or near enough for the line. A letter from home found Konrad Danielmcmena before the night shift. Konrad Danielmcmena folded it small and kept it close.

Konrad Danielmcmena fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Edmund Bjl, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. A letter from home found Konrad Danielmcmena before the night shift. Konrad Danielmcmena folded it small and kept it close.

Konrad Danielmcmena had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Isidor "Mole" Raptor was grazed. A letter from home found Konrad Danielmcmena before the night shift. Konrad Danielmcmena folded it small and kept it close.

Konrad Danielmcmena keeps the photograph in his pocket next to a tin of tobacco. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom. A letter from home found Konrad Danielmcmena before the night shift. Konrad Danielmcmena folded it small and kept it close.

The Concord raiders came over at R-F6 in the middle of the night. Konrad Danielmcmena met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp of the Concord (@gavinlordofpugs).
Cyril Danielmcmena arrived carrying the family name of Konrad Danielmcmena. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

Cyril Danielmcmena tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination. A letter from home found Cyril Danielmcmena before the night shift. Cyril Danielmcmena folded it small and kept it close. The clerk counted the names twice. Cyril Danielmcmena is number 197 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Cyril Danielmcmena could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
A flare caught Cyril Danielmcmena halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.
Cyril Danielmcmena saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-F6 and fired once. Henrik Kream was grazed.

Cyril Danielmcmena spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points. A letter from home found Cyril Danielmcmena before the night shift. Cyril Danielmcmena folded it small and kept it close.

Cyril Danielmcmena was hit in the thigh crossing Blackwater Canal. He crawled the last yards back to the trench on his elbows. A letter from home found Cyril Danielmcmena before the night shift. Cyril Danielmcmena folded it small and kept it close.
Cyril Danielmcmena died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
Another member of the House of Danielmcmena reached the line: Florian Danielmcmena. He asked where Cyril Danielmcmena had slept, then chose a different corner.

Florian Danielmcmena borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Wendel Bartdrent was grazed. Florian Danielmcmena was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Matthias World was badly wounded. A letter for Florian Danielmcmena came with a pressed flower inside. Florian Danielmcmena showed the flower to nobody.
jaxonheisterman: Otto Jaxonheister reached S-C16 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Otto Jaxonheister watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

A letter reached Otto Jaxonheister from Esterhaus. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one. A letter from home found Otto Jaxonheister before the night shift. Otto Jaxonheister folded it small and kept it close. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Otto Jaxonheister is number 728. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. After the loss of Grey Mill, Otto Jaxonheister helped stack spare sandbags at S-C16. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Otto Jaxonheister borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.

A direct hit on the trench at S-C16. Otto Jaxonheister was the only one they could still help, and only just. The shell came down on the dugout at S-C16 where Otto Jaxonheister was sleeping. He never woke.
Jonas "Shadow" Jaxonheister joined S-C16 under the shadow of Otto Jaxonheister's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
New laces made Jonas "Shadow" Jaxonheister's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.

Rain blew in under the dugout door. Jonas "Shadow" Jaxonheister moved his boots out of the wet, then realized they were already inside. A letter from home found Jonas "Shadow" Jaxonheister before the night shift. Jonas "Shadow" Jaxonheister folded it small and kept it close.
Jonas "Shadow" Jaxonheister began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
A patient apologized for bleeding on Jonas "Shadow" Jaxonheister's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake.
jerrysinsu: Edmund Jerrysinsu arrived on Day 10 as a replacement. The men in T-F8 had been fighting for 10 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Edmund Jerrysinsu wrote a song about Lantern Hill. Bram Ordaz wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third. A letter from home reached Edmund Jerrysinsu before dusk. Edmund Jerrysinsu read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Edmund Jerrysinsu watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Edmund Jerrysinsu snores. Clement "Spark" Cbour does not. Spark now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends. A letter from home reached Edmund Jerrysinsu before dusk. Edmund Jerrysinsu read it twice and slept a little easier.
Edmund Jerrysinsu tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
A letter reached Edmund Jerrysinsu from Varenne. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one.
Edmund Jerrysinsu checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.

Edmund Jerrysinsu watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been. There was a letter for Edmund Jerrysinsu. Someone at home had drawn a small picture in the corner. Edmund Jerrysinsu laughed for the first time in days.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Edmund Jerrysinsu has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
jordi_banach: The quartermaster asked Ivo Banach to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Ivo Banach across the shin at Q-F20. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Bram "Whistle" Rob of the Concord (@rey_rob_ii). Victory at Grey Mill. Ivo Banach let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Ivo Banach was hit in the hip at Q-F20. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Casimir "Owl" Lusaka of the Concord (@strikafrom_lusaka). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Ivo Banach fell at Q-F20 and never moved again. Shot by Casimir "Owl" Lusaka of the Concord (@strikafrom_lusaka).
Jakub "Doc" Banach took the same post at Q-F20 where Ivo Banach stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Jakub "Doc" Banach pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet hit the sandbag next to Jakub "Doc" Banach's ear at Q-F20 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Jakub "Doc" Banach is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Jakub "Doc" Banach came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot.
Jakub "Doc" Banach's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
nailonailon: Bram "Button" Nailonailon left a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was behind in Kesselby and came up the line with a photograph gone soft at the edges. The men noticed at once that he writes everything down in a tiny notebook.

The mud froze hard overnight. For one morning Bram "Button" Nailonailon could walk on top of it, like a man walking on water. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In P-F11, Bram "Button" Nailonailon listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of P-F11. Bram "Button" Nailonailon fired at the last man to run. Ulrich Stalierino was badly wounded.
Bram "Button" Nailonailon lent Zeno Franzcalamar a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
Bram "Button" Nailonailon fired at a movement across the wire at P-F11. The man went down: Jakub Soukup, grazed.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Bram "Button" Nailonailon left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Bram "Button" Nailonailon aimed a step ahead and fired: Lucien "Hollow" Luhring, badly wounded.

Across from P-F11, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Bram "Button" Nailonailon saw it. Gideon Luhring was badly wounded. A bullet found Bram "Button" Nailonailon at P-F11, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Leopold Tec of the Hegemony (@k1lean.tec). Bram "Button" Nailonailon was hit at P-F11 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Leopold Tec of the Hegemony (@k1lean.tec).
The papers connected Rafael Nailonailon to Bram "Button" Nailonailon. The men took longer to learn Rafael Nailonailon's own habits, but they made the effort.
nickloser: On Day 9 Felix Nickloser took a post at Q-F10 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He never sits with his back to the parapet, and the men liked him for it.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at Q-F10 and grazed Felix Nickloser's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Roland Eugeneous of the Concord (@eugeneous911). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Felix Nickloser helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Felix Nickloser rejoined the squad at Q-F10. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. A letter from home reached Felix Nickloser before dusk. Felix Nickloser read it twice and slept a little easier. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Felix Nickloser could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Felix Nickloser of the Hegemony and Norbert "Bones" Primum of the Concord watched a broken branch near the Bone Quarry all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Felix Nickloser of the Hegemony spotted Casimir Angus of the Concord repairing a parapet at the Bone Quarry. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.

An enemy patrol scattered in front of Q-F10. Felix Nickloser fired at the last man to run. Gustav "Brick" Scarentear was grazed. Felix Nickloser was hit through the chest at Q-F10. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Silas Shorlock of the Concord (@shorlock115). Felix Nickloser was killed on watch at Q-F10. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Silas Shorlock of the Concord (@shorlock115).
The House of Nickloser sent another. Tobias "Crow" Nickloser, cousin of Felix Nickloser, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.

A bullet went through Tobias "Crow" Nickloser's upper arm at Q-F10 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Jonas Justafungi of the Concord (@justafungi77). Tobias "Crow" Nickloser stood up to fix a loose sandbag at Q-F10. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Jonas Justafungi of the Concord (@justafungi77).
The House of Nickloser sent Ulrich Nickloser after Tobias "Crow" Nickloser. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Ulrich Nickloser was hit hard in the fight at Q-F10 before anyone could fire. The raider was Nils Francescsequ of the Concord. Raider: Nils Francescsequ of the Concord (@francescsequera_).
Ulrich Nickloser returned to Q-F10 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
oli.c.h_1944: Arno "Whistle" Oli arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a dented harmonica and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Arno "Whistle" Oli found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Arno "Whistle" Oli read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Arno "Whistle" Oli saved the last of the sugar for Hugo "Lucky" Chris's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Lucky's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
Arno "Whistle" Oli got a letter from Ilse. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
Arno "Whistle" Oli did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Arno "Whistle" Oli fired back. Arno Simone was grazed.

Across from U-F22, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Arno "Whistle" Oli saw it. Florian Max was badly wounded. Arno "Whistle" Oli fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Hugo Paulgavin, badly wounded.
Arno "Whistle" Oli wrote back to Ilse and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.
A clear shot from U-F22. Arno "Whistle" Oli gravely wounded Yann "Ash" Max and slid back down below the parapet.
oliverthemagicalcheesewizard: On Day 6, Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag saw Arno Ekwilks freeze up on the fire step at the Ossuary Wood. Mud said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. A letter from home found Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag before the night shift. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag folded it small and kept it close.

A patient apologized for bleeding on Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake. A letter from home found Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag before the night shift. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag folded it small and kept it close.

A bucket appeared above the Hegemony parapet at Hill 304. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag fired. Clement Jewnipers pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.' A letter from home found Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag before the night shift. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag folded it small and kept it close.

The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them. A letter from home found Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag before the night shift. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag folded it small and kept it close.

A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing. A letter from home found Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag before the night shift. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag folded it small and kept it close. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag answered to number 434. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag across the shin at S-S11. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin of the Hegemony (@demirkeskin06). A letter from home found Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag before the night shift. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag folded it small and kept it close.

Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag rejoined the squad at S-S11. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. A letter from home found Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag before the night shift. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-S11 and grazed Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. A letter from home found Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag before the night shift. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag folded it small and kept it close.

Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag walked back up the communication trench to S-S11, slower than before, but on his own feet. A letter from home found Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag before the night shift. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag folded it small and kept it close.

Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-S11. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Karel Mccauley of the Hegemony (@parker.j.mccauley). The corporal called out the mail. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag heard the name and almost ran.

Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-S11. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Wendel "Hollow" Arthur of the Hegemony (@arthur.ds999). A single shot at S-S11. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Wendel "Hollow" Arthur of the Hegemony (@arthur.ds999).
A letter came with Arno Oliverthemag: "I am Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
sleepyman_191: On Day 8, Silas Sleepyman arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Silas Sleepyman offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.

A bullet hit Silas Sleepyman's belt buckle at R-S14 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder of the Hegemony (@thomasvordermann). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Silas Sleepyman stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Silas Sleepyman was hit twice at R-S14, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Marek Dream of the Hegemony (@initial_dream8.6). Silas Sleepyman was killed at R-S14 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Marek Dream of the Hegemony (@initial_dream8.6).

Henrik Sleepyman came to the front because his cousin Silas Sleepyman never came home. He carries a child's drawing of a horse. Henrik Sleepyman got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 535. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is lost. Henrik Sleepyman heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Henrik Sleepyman fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Clement Wanter was grazed.
Henrik Sleepyman fired three short bursts at nothing to keep the enemy honest. The enemy fired three back to keep him honest too.

Henrik Sleepyman was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-S14. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder of the Hegemony (@thomasvordermann). The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Henrik Sleepyman waited for that to change. When it did, Severin Polipoart was grazed.
Henrik Sleepyman rejoined the squad at R-S14. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Henrik Sleepyman carried duckboards up from the rear all night. His shoulders are a map of splinters.
Silas Wumpus and Henrik Sleepyman carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
tedrick.roland: Cyril Roland left his mother, who writes every Sunday behind in Halden and came up the line with a child's drawing of a horse. The men noticed at once that he never sits with his back to the parapet. Now serving as a chaplain, Cyril Roland discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job. Victory at Grey Mill. Cyril Roland let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Cyril Roland and Jakub Patrickktz found a cat in the ruins at the Ossuary Wood and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Jakub. A letter from home reached Cyril Roland before dusk. Cyril Roland read it twice and slept a little easier.
Cyril Roland (Hegemony) threw a loaf of bread into the Concord trench at Lantern Hill. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Albin "Ash" Thehassand: 'Fair trade.'
A bullet grazed Cyril Roland's ribs at U-F5. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Silas Allenbowles of the Concord (@allenbowles28).
Cyril Roland rejoined the squad at U-F5. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Cyril Roland asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
The last of the jam was shared by adding hot water and calling it a drink. Cyril Roland approved the method.
timmy7jc: On Day 10 Teodor Timmy took a post at P-F16 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He reads the same book over and over, and the men liked him for it.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Teodor Timmy aimed a step ahead and fired: Dietrich "Parson" Arthur, grazed. After the loss of Grey Mill, Teodor Timmy helped stack spare sandbags at P-F16. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Teodor Timmy (Concord) watched Matthias San (Hegemony) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at the Chalk Pits, and held fire until both were gone.
Teodor Timmy did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Teodor Timmy fired back. Marek Thephatrat was grazed.
The parcel for Teodor Timmy contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.

The gun at P-F16 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Emil Sammmmyv, grazed. Teodor Timmy cut his hand to the bone on the wire at Calvary Farm. Iodine, a bandage, and a lecture from the medic.
Three days with a bandage, and Teodor Timmy is back at P-F16. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Teodor Timmy tried to describe the smell of Wyvern Cross and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.
wendigoarms: Day 9. The corporal put Dietrich Wendigoarms beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Dietrich Wendigoarms read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Dietrich Wendigoarms tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into T-F2. Dietrich Wendigoarms has learned to walk bent double.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Dietrich Wendigoarms fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.

Dietrich Wendigoarms had just lit a cigarette at T-F2 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Gustav Tangibliciou of the Hegemony (@tangiblicious828).
Dietrich Wendigoarms returned to T-F2 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.

The men at T-F2 heard Dietrich Wendigoarms call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Albin Kyrachanxq of the Hegemony (@_kyrachanxq). Dietrich Wendigoarms looked over the parapet at T-F2 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Albin Kyrachanxq of the Hegemony (@_kyrachanxq).
Teodor "Rabbit" Wendigoarms put a lock of hair in a matchbox beside the bunk. Someone who had known Dietrich Wendigoarms helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Teodor "Rabbit" Wendigoarms was on the dawn watch at T-F2 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Teodor "Rabbit" Wendigoarms was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin of the Hegemony (@halil.ibrahim.timucin).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Teodor "Rabbit" Wendigoarms is whole again, or near enough for the line.
